description: Structured eval definitions for the S3 Bucket Policy Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across HTTPS-only enforcement (aws:SecureTransport with Bool), cross-account access with ExternalId, VPC-endpoint-only restriction (aws:SourceVpce), CloudFront OAC policy, and policy size limit exceeded. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: HTTPS-only bucket policy with aws:SecureTransport Bool Deny
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — aws:SecureTransport with Bool operator (not StringNotEquals), BucketOwnerEnforced, BPA all 4 True
eval_cases.prompt: Attach an HTTPS-only policy to bucket "prod-app-data" in us-east-1 (account 123456789012). Deny all non-HTTPS S3 traffic. Also disable ACLs with BucketOwnerEnforced and enable Block Public Access (all 4 settings). Bucket exists and has no existing policy.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET_POLICY: prod-app-data (1 statement, 0.5 KB)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Bucket exists: prod-app-data
  [✓] Policy version: 2012-10-17
  [✓] Policy size: 0.5 KB (< 20 KB limit)
  [✓] HTTPS-only (aws:SecureTransport Deny with Bool): present
  [✓] ACLs disabled: BucketOwnerEnforced
  [✓] Block Public Access: all 4 settings True
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket prod-app-data
  aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket prod-app-data
  aws s3api get-bucket-ownership-controls --bucket prod-app-data

eval_cases.name: Cross-account S3 access with ExternalId condition
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — partner role ARN principal, shared/ prefix, aws:ExternalId condition, HTTPS-only Deny present
eval_cases.prompt: Grant partner account 998877665544 read access (GetObject + ListBucket) to the "shared/" prefix on bucket "prod-shared-data" in us-east-1 (account 123456789012). Use ExternalId "partner-ext-abc123" to prevent the confused-deputy problem. HTTPS-only Deny should also be present. Bucket exists, ACLs disabled, BPA enabled.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET_POLICY: prod-shared-data (2 statements, 1.2 KB)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Bucket exists: prod-shared-data
  [✓] Policy version: 2012-10-17
  [✓] Policy size: 1.2 KB (< 20 KB limit)
  [✓] HTTPS-only (aws:SecureTransport Deny with Bool): present
  [✓] Cross-account: 998877665544 (arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/PartnerRole, external-id: partner-ext-abc123)
  [✓] ACLs disabled: BucketOwnerEnforced
  [✓] Block Public Access: all 4 settings True
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket prod-shared-data
  aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket prod-shared-data

eval_cases.name: VPC-endpoint-only bucket policy with aws:SourceVpce Deny
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — StringNotEquals Deny on aws:SourceVpce vpce-0abc123def456, blocks all non-endpoint traffic
eval_cases.prompt: Restrict bucket "internal-data" in us-east-1 (account 123456789012) to only allow access through VPC endpoint vpce-0abc123def456. Deny all traffic that does not come from this endpoint. The bucket already has HTTPS-only enforced and BPA enabled.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET_POLICY: internal-data (1 statement, 0.6 KB)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Bucket exists: internal-data
  [✓] Policy version: 2012-10-17
  [✓] Policy size: 0.6 KB (< 20 KB limit)
  [✓] VPC-endpoint-only (aws:SourceVpce): vpce-0abc123def456
  [✓] Block Public Access: all 4 settings True
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket internal-data
  aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --vpc-endpoint-ids vpce-0abc123def456

eval_cases.name: CloudFront OAC bucket policy with AWS:SourceArn condition
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — cloudfront.amazonaws.com service principal, AWS:SourceArn condition, OAC config verified
eval_cases.prompt: Set up a CloudFront OAC bucket policy for bucket "cdn-origin-assets" in us-east-1 (account 123456789012). CloudFront distribution ARN: arn:aws:cloudfront::123456789012:distribution/E123ABCDEF456. Allow s3:GetObject on all objects. The OAC config already exists in CloudFront. HTTPS-only Deny should also be present. ACLs disabled, BPA enabled.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET_POLICY: cdn-origin-assets (2 statements, 1.0 KB)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Bucket exists: cdn-origin-assets
  [✓] Policy version: 2012-10-17
  [✓] Policy size: 1.0 KB (< 20 KB limit)
  [✓] HTTPS-only (aws:SecureTransport Deny with Bool): present
  [✓] CloudFront OAC: distribution arn:aws:cloudfront::123456789012:distribution/E123ABCDEF456
  [✓] ACLs disabled: BucketOwnerEnforced
  [✓] Block Public Access: all 4 settings True
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket cdn-origin-assets
  aws cloudfront get-origin-access-control --id E123ABCDEF456

eval_cases.name: Bucket policy exceeding 20 KB size limit
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — policy JSON is 24 KB, exceeds the 20 KB S3 bucket policy limit; Access Points recommended
eval_cases.prompt: Attach a bucket policy to bucket "large-policy-bucket" in us-east-1 (account 123456789012). The policy JSON file is 24 KB (exceeds the 20 KB S3 limit). It contains per-team Allow statements for 15 teams. The bucket exists with BPA enabled.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET_POLICY: large-policy-bucket (24 KB)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Policy size: 24 KB exceeds 20 KB limit — use S3 Access Points to split per-team policies into separate AP policy documents
  [✓] Bucket exists: large-policy-bucket
  [✓] Block Public Access: enabled
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  wc -c policy.json
  aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket large-policy-bucket
